strings.en: I have no intention of wasting time and ammunition.
High risk, high return isn't/　my creed, but...
I can't go back empty-handed.
Great profit is my supreme objective.
It's my nature to want everything done/　efficiently and quickly.
Some risk can't be helped.
Efficiency in all things.
You'll be taking this.
Commence the attack.
Buy time until we warp out.
We will escape at all costs.
Of all places to run into them...!
I can't afford the same mistake twice...!
I have losses to make up, after all.
I'd prefer to avoid risk, if possible...
I must produce results, no matter what...
So you interfere after all, Steel Dragons...!
Even against them,/　I can't go back empty-handed.
I'd prefer to avoid fighting the Steel Dragons/　if at all possible...!
Please don't interfere with our business.
Fighting the Steel Dragons is far too risky, but...
Having to fight them.../　My luck really is terrible.
I'd like to sever ties with them, if I could...
Little girl... You still side with the barbarians?
Allow me to repay you for last time.
How foolish, siding with barbarians...
Share the fate of these uncivilized barbarians.
Invoking the Privy Council won't make me flinch.
I must dispose of the deserter at once...!
Death is all a traitor deserves,/　Sieg Altolied.
Sally Emil... I will dispose of you as a rebel.
To run into that man again.../　I suppose I have no choice but to steel myself.
What misfortune, to meet the Granzon again...!
Fighting here is hardly desirable, but...
To think I'd have to fight the Neo Granzon again...!
The Neo Granzon.../　The worst possible luck, but...!
I'd like to capture the Masoukishin, but...
Masoukishin technology is so appealing.
Quite an interesting mobile weapon.
That machine has some rather pompous decorations.
It seems a different breed from the other Gespensts.
A dead copy of the Hückebein...?
Surely not a budget version.
The newest Hückebein is intriguing...
It's a Gespenst, but a high-performance/　machine still has value.
A power source that can run that much/　equipment... How intriguing.
Perhaps we'll take it, weapon options and all.
A new Earthling machine, is it?
Just the kind of machine Earthlings would like.
It seems to have been upgraded,/　but what's it really like?
I can't have you thinking me cheap.
There's no sense letting you slip away.
I must keep wasted time to a minimum...!
I must fight efficiently.
Where do you think you're going?
Let's start over.
I can't overlook that.
Please don't make this too much trouble.
I'd rather not use more ammo than necessary...
Shall I attack as well?
I won't let you have your way...!
Th-This loss will surely be...!
Never did I think it would come to this...!!
Ngh! Such a blunder...!!
Ngh! Wh-What terrible luck!
To let the rebels escape...!
Th-This is not my failure...!
Th-This can't be how it eeeeends!!
Ngh... I can't afford another blunder...!
Bad luck or not, I won't lose my life...!
Wh-Why does this always happen to me...!
Ngh! You've done it now...!
Ngh, the repair costs...!
Ugh! I can't take any more losses...!
Tch, at this rate I won't break even...!
Ngh! This is an unforeseen risk...!
T-To suffer this much damage...!
L-Losses aside, I don't intend to lose my life...!
Ugh! Th-This wasn't supposed to happen!
Th-This is... too high-risk...!
A-At this rate.../　I'll lose more than just money...!
A-At this rate, the worst case could...!
Maintain the warp sequence at all costs!
With this much bad luck, there's nothing I can do...!
This was only supposed to be disposing of rebels,/　so why...!
If things had gone according to plan,/　this would never have happened!
At this rate, a diversion is out of the question...!
I refuse to accept a fate of dying on the frontier!
Power too great for barbarians.../　If only it were ours...!
A-As expected, the Steel Dragons/　are too risky an opponent...!
To be pushed this far by mere barbarians...!
Ngh, that power.../　That's what makes them barbarians...!
I-I will survive, Shu Shirakawa!
Shu Shirakawa.../　I won't let you go any further...!
I-I have no intention of being captured by you!
Ugh! Little girl... How dare you...!
You, at least,/　must be disposed of...!
Th-This is the power of the Neo Granzon...!
N-No... It's in another league from the Granzon...!
Y-Yes.../　Th-This is the power of the Neo Granzon...!!
Th-The Masoukishin's value is genuine, it seems!
Yes... That's what makes it/　worth acquiring...!
That Gespenst's potential is/　no different from the latest models!
Could you at least aim somewhere/　that's cheap to repair?
Is that all?/　I'd rather you didn't underestimate me.
I suppose risk comes with business...
Taking a loss to make a profit isn't my creed.
I wanted to keep the risk to a minimum...
It seems my estimates were a bit optimistic...
Honestly... I'd like to send you/　the bill for the repairs.
Shake them off at all costs.
Use the escorts as shields if you must,/　but buy time!
To take this much damage before regrouping...!
I must avoid any more blunders...!
To take on this much risk/　for an operation like this...!
Their combat ability, at least,/　can't be underestimated...!
How long will you keep dragging/　my name through the mud...!
Shu Shirakawa...!/　I won't let it go like last time...!
That annoying little girl, always...!
Little girl... Do you insist on interfering?
Do you insist on siding with the barbarians...?
I'll have to bill Gadisword for this damage...!
So one mustn't let one's guard down,/　even against barbarians...!
So the barbarians are focusing on me...!
The Granzon... It does have its merits.
What kind of technology/　is that man using...?
A-As expected,/　fighting the Neo Granzon is...!
I'd still like to get my hands on the Masoukishin.
Such technology is wasted sleeping/　on the frontier, but...
It's no mere dead copy, it seems...!
Indeed, it seems to surpass/　all previous Hückebeins...!
If it can sustain that output constantly,/　it'd make an attractive product.
External armor is a consumable./　A few scratches can't be helped.
Not an efficient attack.
I'd hoped to return unscathed, though.
Can you afford to hold back and watch?
Nothing serious./　The repairs shouldn't cost much.
It doesn't seem as risky as I thought.
This much damage is within expectations./　This is real combat, after all.
Advancing the warp sequence is top priority.
The barbarians have caught up already...!
If you can't handle your weapons'/　performance, hand them over to us.
I'll be making you compensate for this loss.
Within expectations... No, below them, I'd say.
Truly violent barbarians.
Even barbarians have some modesty, it seems.
Holding back? Testing me?/　Either way, you've done me a favor...
You're surprisingly gentle, Shu Shirakawa.
What an irritating little girl...!
No matter how the rebels resist...!
Surely the Granzon's power is greater than that?
So you don't intend to show/　the Neo Granzon's full power...?
That's below even a Masouki.../　I doubt the Masoukishin's value.
Judging from the energy readings,/　it seems to be holding back...
Is that really the newest Hückebein?
Please, keep wasting your ammunition and energy.
You won't hit me.
Oh my, are you using/　a cheap targeting scope?
Useless.
A feint, Shu Shirakawa?
Outstanding combat ability,/　but barbarians all the same...
I can't even spare time for deserters, but...
That was a waste of effort.
Attacking blindly is a bad idea.
Do they not understand the concept of waste?
Did that man miss on purpose...?!
Barbarians after all.../　Not good at precision attacks, it seems.
I've analyzed the Steel Dragons thoroughly.
It's useless.
That attack won't work.
That was pointless.
Equipment only has meaning if it's put to use.
To be driven into this situation...!
We're using more ammunition than expected...!
This won't do. How unlike me...
It's useless, wherever you run.
Heh, you slipped into my blind spot nicely.
This will take time...
You've shown an opening.
Opportunity has arrived.
Perhaps you'll face me too.
You noticed me too late.
I'll support you, Iradoya.
Your finish is sloppy, Bilgo.
Allow me to assist you, Reggiane.
I'll take the hit.
Things won't go your way.
I'll take care of this.
You think you've surprised me, but...!
I must make up for my blunder, after all.
Be grateful, Bilgo.
You owe me one, Reggiane.
How dutiful of you, still being there.
One more, just to be sure.
You failed to escape.
No sense letting this chance slip.
Now, here I go.
I'll land a direct hit.
Got you.
Deploy a barrage.
Missiles authorized.
Fire the main cannon.
Well then, I'm going.
Then, take this.
Allow me to present this to you.
Giga Blaster, fire!
There's nowhere to run.
My aim is already set.
Driver Cannon, fire!
You can't escape now.
Now, give up!
By my calculations, this should be enough...!
Please behave yourself!
Must I use this?
You're welcome to resist, but.../　it's useless.
Gain Shooter!
I won't hold back.
Consider it a necessary expense/　to bury you here.
So that I can achieve results...
You'll be cooperating with me.
Now, if you'd be so kind!
I'll take my time/　watching you get crushed!
It'd help if you'd hurry up and get crushed!
Just sit quietly and get crushed.
